releaseNotes:
﻿## Guest Inbox
- Confirm a linked inquiry as a booking from the email thread (or assign a room first when needed)
- When a contact has multiple upcoming stays, choose which inquiry/booking to link — past stays are not auto-linked
- Save a sender as a contact without creating a booking; Saved contact / New email labels on threads
- Clearer inbox stages and labels (including Form sent); Back to Inbox navigation
- Booking form quick reply (renamed from availability); Conference files next to Standard files in mail settings

## Bookings & calendar
- Weekly room labels no longer repeat couple names

## Reports & statistics
- Occupancy and report accuracy improvements
